property.name: answer
property.description: The answer to the question of the customer, in the language of the question. Based only on the product details returned by the tools.

property.name: isInStock
property.description: True when at least one variant of the product is available. False otherwise, and also when the product was not found or the availability is unknown. Never null.

property.name: confidence
property.description: How well the product details support the answer: 'high', 'medium', or 'low'. Use 'low' when the tools returned nothing useful.

property.name: relatedSkus
property.description: Concrete SKUs that match the question best, for example the variants in the requested size or color. An empty list when none apply, never null.
